ModMetaData.name: GTI Runtime GC
ModMetaData.author: WarezCrawler (fork of user19990313, louize, RunningBugs)
ModMetaData.description:
Personal GTI fork/maintenance copy of RuntimeGC (the in-game cleaner). All credit for the original mod goes to user19990313, with the 1.5/1.6 fork by louize and RunningBugs.
<size=20>RuntimeGC In-Game Cleaner</size>
- Remove unnecessary World Pawns to alleviate burden of GameSystem - Clear AvoidGrids to reduce the size of your savegame - Remove useless members (dead or of other factions) in an animal family - Remove filth in HomeArea, and snow - Remove corpses in current map - Remove BattleLog entries - Fix some faction relationship errors (those caused by mod conflicts are not included!) - Re-generate faction leaders to fix some CommTable issues - Reclaim memory used by GameSystem to boost game performance
Warning: please back up your save before using this.
Original repository: https://github.com/user19990313/RimWorld-RuntimeGC
